SELECT si.id, si.item_type, si.product_id, si.seckill_price, si.seckill_stock, si.sold_count, si.per_limit, si.status, p.name AS product_name, p.cover_url AS product_image, p.price AS original_price, sa.name AS activity_name, COALESCE(ps.spec_name, '无规格') AS spec_name FROM seckill_item si LEFT JOIN product p ON si.product_id = p.id AND si.item_type = 1 LEFT JOIN seckill_activity sa ON si.activity_id = sa.id LEFT JOIN product_spec ps ON si.product_spec_id = ps.id WHERE si.item_type = 1
AND si.activity_id IS NULL
AND si.activity_id = #{activityId}
ORDER BY si.created_at DESC

SELECT si.id, si.item_type, si.coupon_id, si.per_limit, si.status, c.name AS coupon_name, c.discount_type AS coupon_discount_type, c.discount_amount AS coupon_discount_amount, c.discount_rate AS coupon_discount_rate, c.remained AS coupon_remained, c.total AS coupon_total, c.per_limit AS coupon_per_limit, c.receive_start AS coupon_receive_start, c.receive_end AS coupon_receive_end, sa.name AS activity_name FROM seckill_item si LEFT JOIN coupon c ON si.coupon_id = c.id AND si.item_type = 2 LEFT JOIN seckill_activity sa ON si.activity_id = sa.id WHERE si.item_type = 2
AND si.activity_id IS NULL
AND si.activity_id = #{activityId}
ORDER BY si.created_at DESC

SELECT si.id, si.item_type, si.product_id, si.seckill_price, si.seckill_stock, si.sold_count, si.per_limit, si.status, p.name AS product_name, p.cover_url AS product_image, p.price AS original_price, COALESCE(ps.spec_name, '默认') AS spec_name FROM seckill_item si LEFT JOIN product p ON si.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_spec ps ON si.product_spec_id = ps.id WHERE si.activity_id = #{activityId} AND si.item_type = 1 AND si.status = 1 ORDER BY si.created_at DESC

SELECT si.id, si.item_type, si.coupon_id, si.per_limit, si.status, -- 券信息 c.name AS coupon_name, c.discount_type AS coupon_discount_type, c.discount_amount AS coupon_discount_amount, c.discount_rate AS coupon_discount_rate, c.remained AS coupon_remained, c.total AS coupon_total, c.per_limit AS coupon_per_limit, c.receive_start AS coupon_receive_start, c.receive_end AS coupon_receive_end FROM seckill_item si LEFT JOIN coupon c ON si.coupon_id = c.id WHERE si.activity_id = #{activityId} AND si.item_type = 2 AND si.status = 1 ORDER BY si.created_at DESC
